tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bden gnyis zhal can

sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga bde ba chen po'i dpal 'bar ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ na mo gu ra we/ ye shes bskal ba'i me yi gzi 'od can/ /sgeg 'chang du mas rnam brgyan drag mo che/ /mi phyed sngags kyi de nyid rtag 'char ba/ /rdo rje btsun mos bdag la thugs brtser mdzod/ /dpag yas sgrub thabs chu gter bsrubs pa las/ /nam mkha'i nor bu dang mtshungs snying po ste/ /gsang ba'i man ngag o rgyan las byung ba/ /bden gnyis zhal can mchod pa'i cho ga brtsam/ /de yang dus bzang po la stegs bu'i steng du rdul tshon gyi maṇ+ḍal 'dri ste/ pad+ma dmar po'am/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ lte ba zlum po la chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po rtse mo mdun du bstan pa/ gru bcar ljang khu bya/ pad+ma'i phyi rol du rgyas par na dur khrod rdo rwa 'od zer 'phreng bas bskor ba 'bri/ bsdu na dur khrod med kyang chog/shin tu bsdu na rdo rwa me ri'i tshab tu re kha nag po dang dmar pos bskor ba tsam byed pa'ang yod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la thod pa myos byed kyis bkang ba dang*/ me long chang gis brlan pa la sin+dhu ra snyoms par bkram/ gser gyi smyu gu g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis gzung nas 'bri bar bshad kyang*/ myu gu ji ltar 'os pa gser gyi mtshan par byas te g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub gis bzung*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis kyang smyu gu'i rtsa ba nas 'dzin pa tsam mdzad pa'i srol yin/ chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang du/ rtsa sngags yig 'phreng bdun pa 'bri na/ oṃ gsum la 'phreng gcig /sngags tshan gsum la re re/ hūṃ gsum la gcig /phaṭa gsum la gcig /swāhā la gcig go /gsum du byed na/ yig 'bru dang po bcu bdun la gcig /de nas bcu gcig la gcig /de nas bzhi la gcig go /chos 'byung gi phyi rol phyogs bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba lag bzhi pa re re 'bri/ mdun gyi de mdun drang thad la mi byed de/

rtse mo g.yon du bya/ ngag sbyor gyi gnad gcig kyang yod do/ kha cig sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor snod du bcug dar dmar gyis 'gebs pa'i srol yang yod de phal cher mi byed pa'i dar dmar po'i gur khang ngam/ bla bre'am/ yol khang gis bcad/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyad dang gtor ma lnga bshams/ rdor dril/ nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ rol mo dang mig dar sogs 'og tu dgos pa rnams tshogs par bshams/ bum pa yang spyi dang mthun par 'cha'o/ /sngon 'gro gtor ma gnas yo byin rlabs dang*/ / zhu 'bul skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems bsgom/ /drug po spyi mthun sngon 'gro yin zhes bya/ / de nas cho ga'i rim pa la 'jug ste/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ phaiṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā kī ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+yaho/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta pre ta bi shā tsa/ un+ma da/ a pasmā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇān+tu sa ma ya rāk+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshān+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thai ṣaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi wa tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karta ya/ sat+su khaṃ/ bi bṛd+dha/ sa ha yi ka bha wān+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai be t+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/

sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃḥ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /gnod sbyi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis 'ches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*/ /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la gsungs/ /srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel dang chos 'phel dang*/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang*/ 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang par 'tshal na/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i phyogs skyong rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad srung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams gtor ma'i lhag ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig /sum+bha drag tu bzlas la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ gong bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i rin po che/ sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang dang bcas shing thogs pa med pa'i dbus su/ āḥlas ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las gyur pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ yul nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra hūṃ pe āḥhūṃ/

oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra nai we t+ye āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe ṭa pra tsa li te pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta nā da saṃ bha wata/ badz+ra dharma hriḥd ya/ san+to ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swā hā/ de nas spro na zhu 'bul bya/ bsdu na ma byas kyang 'gal ba med/ skyabs 'gro ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par bgyi'o/ / lan gsum bya/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs/ hūṃ la thim bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/

oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ka bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūṃ phaṭa/ ces mang du bzla/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyam/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ / thugs rje chen po bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnas kyi nges pa bla mar gsol 'debs dang*/ /tshogs zhing go cha nang mchod byin rlabs gnyis/ /lag pa'i bya ba srung 'khor sngon 'gro yin/ /ngag gsum gzhal yas khang dang dam tshig bskyed/ /ye shes spyan 'dren go cha dbang bskur bya/ /dag dran mchod dang bstod pa bzlas pa dang*/ /slar yang mchod bstod gsol ba 'debs pa ste/ /de dag bdag bskyed sgom pa'i dngos gzhi yin/ /de yang rang nyid nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul du gdong phyogs pa'am phyogs par mos la/ 'di skad ces brjod de/ bdag nyid gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid chos kyi dbyings chos kyi 'byung gnas o ḍ-i ya na rdo rje'i gnas su gyur/ rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma he ru ka dang gnyis su med pa 'dzum bag dang bcas shing*/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ skyabs gnas thams cad kyi ngo bor bzhugs/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ / bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/

/ gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes lan gsum/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyang steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pād+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūṃ/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai we t+ye/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ ces bya'o/ /'og nas ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'bar gyis mchod ces byung tshad 'di dang 'dra bar bya/ thal mo snying khar sbyor bzhin pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /theg chen bdud rtsi rab bshad par/ /'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs/ /ji srid 'khor ba gnas kyi bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol bar 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyid nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / lan gsum/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid la thim/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ baṃ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hreṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ nang mchod byin rlabs thun mong ba ni/ sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa/ de'i nang gi shar du go las ba lang gi sha bruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ nub tu da las rta'i sha dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa/

lho ru ku las khyi'i sha aṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su na las mi'i sha hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ shar lhor baṃ las dri chen lam gyis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu ra las rak+ta māṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub byang du ma las rkang mar baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang shar du mu las dri chu tāṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su shu las byang sems baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba'i steng du baṃ dmar po de las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi byin rlabs ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi rnam par spyan drangs te baṃ la thim/ baṃ yig kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas pa zhu nas rdzas la thim/ rlung gis me 'bar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol nas mang por spel te bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum du brjod/ khyad par gyi nang mchod byin rlabs ni/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis dbus nas brtsams te chos 'byung g.yon skor du bri tshul bya zhing*/ oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod / mthe bong gi rtser oṃ/ mthe chung gi rtser āḥ 'khrig ma'i ngos la hūṃ/ lag mthil du baṃ/ de nyid kyi gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar chos 'byung gi nang g.yon zur du oṃ/ g.yas zur du āḥ mdun zur hūṃ/ dbus su baṃ yig ste yi ge bzhi 'khod par gyur pa las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar gyi rnam pa can sbyor mtshams nas spyan drangs la thod pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi la thim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/

lan gsum g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs la/ g.yon pa'i mthe chung nas mthe bo'i bar sor mo lnga dang*/ thams cad 'dus pa'i sen mo'i ngos la bdud rtsi'i thig le bya zhing*/ oṃ baṃ nas phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar brjod/ yi ge 'bru gsum lan drug brjod cing*/ de rnams la bdud rtsi gtor/ yang 'bru gsum lan gsum brjod cing lag pa'i lus thams cad la byug tshul bya/ go cha drug po rang lus la thim par gyur/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis gnas dang rdzas la phyogs kun du gtor/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ hri gha gha/ gha ta ya/ gha ta ya/ sarba duṣ+taṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ bgegs thams cad bskrad/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes dag pa gsum gyi sngags brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las rang lus gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pas yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal med khang gi dbus su/ chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba rtsa ba phra ba thur du bstan cing*/ gdengs ka rgyas pa gyen du phyogs pa'i steng gur du phub pa'i tshul rus sbal gyi rgyab ltar mtho ba/ phyi rol tu dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i nang du ngag sngags kyi yig 'bru dang*/ sems lha sku'i rnam par gyur pa ni/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar mi ro ser po mgo g.yon du bstan pa'i snying gar oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du baṃ dmar po las 'od 'phros/ sa gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs/

phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad tshur gcig tu 'dus shing thim pa las bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ ban+dhu dzi ba ka dang*/ sin+dhu ra dang*/ se 'bru'i me tog dang 'char ka'i mdangs kyis 'khyud pa/ drag po chen mo 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa mo nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa'i gzi brjid can rtsa zhal lha mo'i rnam pa 'dzum khro chags pa'i nyams can hur bag chags pa/ mche ba'i myu gu lhag ger gtsigs shing rgya cher bzhad pa mo/ g.yas zhal phag gdong shin tu khros shing gyen du phyogs pas gzigs pa/ drag shul chen po'i nga ro can/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon du rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po gyen du bsgreng ba/ dbu skra nag po cung zad li ba sil bur grol zhing ban bun du bskyod pas phyogs cha 'gengs pa/ dmar zhing bkra la zlum por g.yo ba'i spyan gsum dang ldan cing khro gnyer g.yo ba/ rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng ba la brgyus pa'i thod skam lnga'i 'phreng ba can/ rgyu mas sbrel ba'i khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu ste mi rus las grub pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gcer bu lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho la bab pa'i gzhon nu ma ze'u 'bru gsal bar bzhad pa'i mtsho skyes dang nu 'bur zung dag mtho la rgyas pa/ sked skabs phra zhing sku lus gsum 'khyog nyid kyi ldem bag can/ zhabs g.yon rkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyi bzhugs pa/ ma lus pa'i sprul pa 'char ba'i sku can bskal ba'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na sgeg cing rol ba'o/ /lte bar chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ yig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la dpa' dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/

'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor bzhin pas phaiṃ zhes brjod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hreṃ hriṃ ser mo skyong byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo rnams su gyur/ slar yang baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar phaiṃ/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i bum thod thogs te mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ rang sngags gsung bzhin pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang la thim/ de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ pad+ma'i gdan ni nyon mongs pas ma gos pa'o/ /mi ro'i gdan ni rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong nyid do/ /nyi ma ni bde ba chen po'i snang ba rgyas pa'o/ /sku mdog dmar mo ni thugs rjes sems can la chags pa'o/ /zhabs gnyis ni bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'o/ /gri gug ni dug gsum gcod pa'o/ /thod pa ni bde ba skyong ba'o/ /thod skam lnga ni rigs lnga'o/ /mgo rlon gyi 'phreng ba ni yi ge lnga bcu dag pa'o/ /phyag rgya lnga ni pha rol tu phyin pa lnga'o/ /zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyang ba ni mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /skra grol ba ni mtshan mas ma bcings pa'o/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni thabs dang ma bral ba'o/

/sku gcig pu ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gcer bu ni sgrib pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /me dpung 'bar ba ni/ kun tu khyab pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba spro ba'o/ / zhes so/ /lte ba'i baṃ yig las/ khwa gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma/ khyi gdong ma dang phag gdong ma/ /gshin rje brtan ma pho nya mo/ /mche ba ma dang 'joms ma ste/ / ma mo brgyad po sku mdog ljang khu/ cang te'u dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs shing*/ mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spros te/ mchod pa dang bstod pa'i las mdzad par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyi phyi mchod dang oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ / rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /rnam par rtog med yang dag rtog /yid ni rab tu mi gnas shing*/ /yid la med cing dran pa med/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid/ / bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ / zhes pas bstod/ mchod ma rnams lte ba'i bam la thim/ yi ge 'bru gsum lan gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi lan gsum myangs/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sar+b+ba bud+dha ḍā ki ni ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zes ngag bzlas dang*/ yid bzlas dang*/ 'gog pa'i bzlas pa rnams ci rigs par bya'o/ /slar yang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bā rā hī sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/

de bzhin du/ pad+yaṃ nas shap+da 'i bar la'ang sbyar/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ bdud rtsi myang*/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī nas/ kha ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ kyi bar rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas mdun bskyed ni/ bsang sbyangs gzugs brnyan gsum bskyed cing*/ dkyil 'khor dam ye go cha dang*/ / dbang bskur mchod bstod bzlas pa dang*/ /gsol btab mdun bskyed bsgrub pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ sum+bha sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ yo ga shud+dho3haṃ gis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dkyil 'khor 'og ma rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ hūṃ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor dur khrod pad+ma'i khor yug dang bcas pa'i lte bar gzhal yas khang chos 'byung dang bcas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bar ma bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor ni/ mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ āḥlas byung ba'i ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho lta bur 'khyil ba'i dbus su chos 'byung dmar po'i g.yon gyi zur du oṃ/ g.yas kyis zur du āḥ mdun gyi zur du hūṃ/ de rnams kyi dbus su baṃ/ yi ge de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad khyab/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ snod bcud thams cad kyi dwangs ma rnams kyang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus/ thod pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes rnam pa lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan lnga/ dkyil 'khor steng ma sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor ni/ bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi steng du/

oṃ las byung ba'i chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin can gyi nang gi dbus kyi cha la/ rten dang bral ba'i tshul gyi bar snang la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ nas swāhā/ phyi rol phyogs bzhir g.yung drung 'khyil ba dkar po lag bzhi dang ldan zhing g.yon skor du 'khor ba/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gnas su gyur pa'o/ /de ltar rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin sku gsum rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum po de thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi zhes pa nas/ rus sbal gyi rgyab ltar mtho ba/ phyi rol dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma zhes pa nas/ 'dus shing thim pa las/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zha ེ sa pa nas/ rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rkang brgyad kyi bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyis tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad khyab/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad/ bcom ldan 'das ma nyid kyi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur/ de las kyang 'od zer byung bdag gi snying gar thim/ skabs 'dir/ oṃ gsum ma ci nus bzla/ bzlas pa 'jog khar/ oṃ sum+bha sogs rig pa'i rgyal po lan bdun tsam bzla/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'ang lan dgu sogs ji ltar 'os pa bzla/ de nas pad skor du 'gro ba'i thal mo sbyar nas/ /bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rdo rje phag mo'i lha tshogs 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la phyag rgya chen mo mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/

ji srid de ma thob kyi bar du yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad stsol ba dang*/ sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ gnod pa thams cad las skyab pa dang*/ bgegs dang nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang ye shes dang*/ yon tan gyi chos thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ khams gsum gyi skye 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ gdul dka' ma lus pa tshar gcod cing 'dul ba dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ ral gri dang*/ ro langs dang*/ gnod sbyin mo dang*/ bcud kyi len dang*/ gter chen po la sogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsol ba dang*/ yang dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su dkri bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du yang rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag cag gis mchod pa phul ba rnams dgyes pa'i thugs kyis bzhes par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ spyan 'dren mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod gos zung dang*/ rig ma bcu drug rin chen bdun/ /'dod yon lnga dang nang mchod gnyis/ rjes chags yid byung bstod dang glu/ /gtor chog rnams te mchod pa'i sdom/ / rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes mgron spyan drangs/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bzang zhing rgya che la dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang par gyur/

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ zhes mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa rī wa ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pratīts+tsha swāhā/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas khyed la 'phul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ nas badz+ra pād+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ lha yi me tog shin tu dmar/ /dri zhim shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /me tog de ring bzhes nas su/ /'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /oṃ nas badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ oṃ tsan dan ga bur dang bcas pa'i/ /dri zhim spos me dge ba yi/ /mthu dang ldan par bya ba 'di/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /dhū paṃ= oṃ mar me 'od zer 'bar ba 'di/ /ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms par byed/ /a yi mig 'byed bkra shis pa'i/ /mar me khyed kyis bzhes su gsol/ /dī paṃ= oṃ sna tshogs lha yi dri zhim pa/ /sna tshogs ga bur rnam brgyan pa/ /sna tshogs yi ge hūṃ las byung*/ /dri 'di 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol/ /gan+dha= oṃ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /nai wi t+ya= /oṃ pa ṭa ha dang cang te'u sogs/ dung dang rnga sogs sgra dbyangs dang*/ /yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs rnams/ /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /badz+ra shap+ta=

gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha re re la yang zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog=/ was+t+ra ye= /oṃ wī ni badz+ri ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo pi waṃ ma/ /ston mkha'i mdog mtshungs pi waṃ lag /pi waṃ sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra wī ni badz+ri ṇi pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ wāṃ se badz+ri ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo gling bu ma/ /gser gyi mdog can gling bu'i lag /gling bu'i sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas= /waṃ se= oṃ mri taṃ ga badz+ri ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo rdza rnga ma/ /ban+dhu'i mdog can rdza rnga'i lag /rdza rnga'i sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas= /mri taṃ ga= /oṃ mu ra dze= /rdo rje lha mo rnga zlum ma/ /margad mdog mtshungs rnga zlum lag /rnga zlum sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas = /mu ra dze= /oṃ ha s+ya= /rdo rje lha mo bzhad pa mo/ / kang shu'i mdog mtshungs bzhad pa'i zhal/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas= /ha s+ya= /oṃ lā s+ya= /rdo rje lha mo sgeg pa mo/ /dbang sngon mdog mtshungs sgeg pa'i tshul/ /snyems pa'i lus dang glur ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas= /lā s+ya= /oṃ gī ti= /rdo rje lha mo glu dbyangs ma/ /'char ka'i mdog mtshungs glu len ma/ /glu dang rol mo'i sgra ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas= /gī ta= /oṃ nṛ ti= /rdo rje lha mo gar mkhan ma/ /ma rgad mdog mtshungs gar mdzad ma/ /lag pa gar byed rkang stabs bsgyur/ /nam mkha' khyab pas= / nṛ ta= /oṃ puṣ+pe= /rdo rje lha mo me tog ma/ /gur gum mdog mtshungs me tog

lag /me tog char dang rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha' khyab pas= /puṣ+pe= /oṃ dhū pe= /rdo rje lha mo bdug spos ma/ /du ba'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos lag / bdug pa'i sprin dang rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha' khyab pas= /dhū pe= /oṃ dī pe= /rdo rje lha mo mar me ma/ /glog 'od mdog mtshungs mar me'i lag /mar me'i 'od dang rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha' khyab pas= / dī pe= /oṃ gan+dhe= /rdo rje lha mo dri chab ma/ /pri yang mdog mtshungs dung chos lag /dri yi char dang rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha' khyab pas= /gan+dhe= /oṃ rū pa = rdo rje lha mo gzugs mdzes ma/ /ston zla'i mdog mtshungs me long lag /yid 'ong gzugs dang rgyan ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas= /rū pa= /oṃ ra sa= /rdo rje lha mo zhal zas ma/ / dza pa'i mdog mtshungs zhal zas lag /zhal zas bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma/ / nam mkha' khyab pas= /ra sa= /oṃ spar+ṣe= / rdo rje lha mo na bza' ma/ /margad mdog mtshungs na bza'i lag /gos dang reg dang 'khyud par ldan/ /nam mkha' khyab pas= /spar+ṣe= /oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ri ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo chos dbyings ma/ /kun+da'i mdog mtshungs chos 'byung lag / zag pa med pa'i bde ster ma/ / nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra dharma dhā tu badz+ri ṇi pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ / 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun chad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wa ra tsakra rat+na pū dzi te āḥhū?ṃ/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /dbul zhing 'phongs pa rgyun chad nas/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog= /ma ṇi rat+na pū dzi te= /btsun mo= ma rig mun pa rgyun chad nas/ / shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs te/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog / wa stī= /blon po rin chen=

/phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*/ /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog= /ma hā sta= /glang po rin chen= /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal zhing*/ /bla med theg pa rab bzhon nas/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog= /ha stī rat+na= /rta mchog rin chen= /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol nas/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob ste/ /sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par shog= /tu raṃ ga a shwa= /dmag dpon rin chen= /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog= /khaḍ+ga== kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan 'phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ rū pa ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ /phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin dang*/ /yon tan tshig mchog sgra dbyangs ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor= /bzhes shig= /shap+ta ka ma gu ṇa= /phyogs dus kun na tsan dan sbrul snying dang*/ /a ka ra la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha= /bzhes shig= /gan+dhe= /phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog mchis pa rnams/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor= /bzhes shig= /ra sa= /phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed rnams= /mos blos dkyil 'khor= /bzhes shig= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pā ri wā ra spar+ṣe ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi t+ye āḥhūṃ/ khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ nang mchod la gnyis kyi skabs 'dir tshes bcu'i dus sam= /rang gzhan gyi don gal che ba'i gnas skabs su/ bdud rtsi'i mchod pa rgyas pa 'bul bar spro na/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun phyogs su/ dam rdzas sbyar ba'i myos byed kyis gang ba'i thod pa stegs bu la bkod pa dang*/

chang phal pa'ang dri bzang gi chu dang*/ dmar chen dang 'o ma la sogs pa mchod yon gyi snod so sor 'grub na bzang*/ bsdu na de dag gcig tu bsres pa'i mchod yon gyi snod dung chos dang bum pa sogs ji ltar 'os pa dang*/ snod gcig tu mtheb kyu ba las brgyan pa sum cu so lnga nas brgya lnga bcu'i bar ji ltar 'os pa spungs/ snod gcig tu me tog dmar po dngos sam 'bru kha dog bsgyur ba blugs/ de ltar nang mchod mchod yon mtheb kyu me tog rnams bzhi tshoms su bzhag pa'i dkyil du stegs bu la bzed zhal bkod/ spos phor/ mar me/ dri chab rnams cung zad thag ring pa gcig gi rgyab phyogs su bshams/ nang mchod bsangs sbyangs nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyi bar gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ mchod pa rnams kyang bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ gis bar gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes btags pa nyer gcig nas brgya rtsa'i bar brjod/ sngags re re bzhin las byed pa bzhin/ nang mchod mchod yon/ mtheb kyu/ me tog rnams nas lan re 'bul/ slob dpon gyis cang te'u dang dril bu'i sgra byed/ de'i rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra pā rā hī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya mi nī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mo ha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sañtsa li ni ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra san+t+ra sa ni ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍi kā ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ka s+ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ u lu ka s+yai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa na s+yai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sū ka ra s+yai ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ḍ-i ḍh+ra ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma du ti ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃ ṣ+ti ṇe ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha ni ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rnams la'ang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gsum btags pas 'bul/ mjug tu rol chen dang rkang brgyad lta bu'i bstod pa gang rung gcig bya'o/

/de nas dkyus kyi nang mchod 'bul te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ zhes nang mchod byin rlabs kha gso/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las rmad byung bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mtshan 'di zhes bya ba'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ dbang phyug brgyad ldan khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ /rgyal ba'i yum gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug lha lcam dpal mo mdzad/ /mu stegs 'dul mdzad dpa' bo bi rū pa/ /spros bral don gzigs a wa dhū ti'i zhabs/ / gdod ma'i mgon po dpal ldan shā bā ri/ /mthu stobs nus pa mngon gyur rgyal pas byin/ /rdo rje btsun mos byin brlabs sangs rgyas byin/ /gnas lnga mthar son de wa ā ka ra/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad ha du dkar po'i zhabs/ /zab don mnga' bdag dpyal lo kun rdor mtshan/ /bla ma mnyes mdzad skyi ston dkon mchog 'bar/ /bshes gnyen dam pa rgyal tshab rin po che/ /byang chub thugs ldan lo ts+tsha byams pa dpal/ /chen po'i gtsug rgyan mkhan po bsod nams dbang*/ /byang chub thugs ldan sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs/ /dpag yas gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin yang rtse ba/ /mtha' yas shes bya'i gnas rig rin chen grub/ /gzhon nu bsod nams mtshan can brag nag pa/ /mkhas btsun dam pa mkhan chen rin rgyal ba/ /dam pas rjes bzung rgyal dbang grags pa dang*/ / mtshan mchog ldan pa rgyal ba phyag na ba/ /byin rlabs mchog ldan 'dzims chen bsod rgyal ba/ /nges don bstan 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug mtshan/ /legs pa'i lam ston kun dga' dpal 'byor te/ /bslab gsum ldan pa dkon mchog rin chen zhabs/ /gnas lugs mngon gyur lung rig rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i srog shing rje btsun mgon/

/brgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul/ /mtha' yas 'gro kun 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dpal/ /ye shes rnam lnga'i rgya mtsho thob par shog /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ spro na re re bzhin du rnam dag bdud rtsi sogs tshig gsum sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas 'di skad ces/ gzhan yang rtsa ba'i bla ma/ brgyud pa'i bla ma/ dbang bskur rgyud bshad/ man ngag nos/ chos kyi 'brel ba'i snga ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /yum gyur sgyu 'phrul chen mo bcom ldan ma/ /mkha' spyod gtso mo rdo rje phag mo la/ /rnam dag= /rdo rje phag mo gzhan dang gshin rje ma/ /rmongs byed ma dang dpal ldan skyong byed ma/ /skrag byed ma dang rdo rje tsaṇ+ḍi ka /rnam dag= /rigs kyi btsun mo 'khor los bsgyur ma bzhi/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi gnas sogs rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje ma mo ma rung 'jom mdzad brgyad/ /rnam dag= /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig rnal 'byor ma/ /re re'ang bye ba phrag re'i rjes 'brang bcas/ /thun mong min gyur mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la/ /rnam dag= gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi= /gzhan yang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs thams cad kyi== /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi== gzhan yang chos 'khor srung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi== /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*/ tshan do dang nye ba'i tshan do/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/

yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma sprul pa'i sku 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi== /zhing skyong bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi = gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi= /gzhan yang bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag /grong bdag /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi= /'gro ba rigs drug /lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i rigs drug gi sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim nas/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swā da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi myangs/ de nas rjes chags ni/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba sogs lan lnga tsam byed/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas yid byung ni/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum byed pa'am yang na 'di skad ces/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang bdag gi mos pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig

/oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya/ ā brta ya ho/ na maḥs man+ta bung+nghā nāṃ/ a bhi sma ra s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ dharma dhā tu a ka sha sa man+ta maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri sho dha maṇ+ḍa le ma ma pra ṇi dhi puṇ+ye dz+nyā na ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba le na sap+ta swa s+thā na ba lañtsa ye swāhā/ de nas bstod pa ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra wā rā hī waṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma ār+ya a pa ra dzi te trai lo kya mā te mahā bi d+yai shwa ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhu ta bha ya wa he mahā badz+re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa na a dzi te a pa ra dzi te ba sh+yaṃ ka ri nai tra bh+ra ma nī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi ṣa ṇi sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ka rā li nai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mas+t+ra sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa ra dza ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wa rā hī mahā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri kha ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces rkang brgyad la rol chen byed/ de nas dril gsil dang bcas te/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i yum gyur bcom ldan ma/ /chos dbyings shes rab pha rol phyin ma'i dngos/ /zag med bde stong lhan cig skyes ma'i sku/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje phag mo sna tshogs bde ma dang*/ /bdag med ye shes dbang phyug sna tshogs yum/ /rdo rje sgrol ma ro langs ma la sogs/ /sna tshogs mtshan 'chang khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e yig dpal ldan pad+ma bha ga dang*/ /gsang ba chos 'byung chos dbyings nam mkha'i khams/ /seng ge'i khri sogs brda thabs du mas mtshon/ /shes rab lha mo'i gtso la=/ chos dbyings rang bzhin mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs/ /don dam 'khor 'das srid pa gsum gyi gzugs/ /mtha' yas sprul pa'i snang ba phyogs brgyar 'bar/ /sku yi dbang phyug ma la= /zab mo gsang sngags chos dbyings sgra brgya pa/
/nges tshig ming don rgya mtsho'i 'jug pa can/ /mtha' dag mgon gyi gsung dbyangs rdo rje ma/ /

gzhom med lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin spros bral mi 'gyur chos dbyings dang*/ /ma lus shes bya'i gnas tshul kun gsal ba/ /kun mkhyen ye shes lhun grub rnam mi rtog /mkha' spyod thugs kyi rdo rjer= /gang gi rnam 'phrul yid bzhin sgyur mdzad pas/ /dpag yas 'gro ba'i don sgrub mthu dpal can/ / 'phrul ldan dbang phyug mnga' bdag rnal 'byor ma/ /sgyu 'phrul bde ba'i gter la= /rdo rje lha mo khyod thugs ye shes dang*/ /sku dang 'phrin las dbyings dang nam mkha' ste/ /'di dag brtan g.yo kun la lhan cig khyab/ /kun khyab kun 'gro'i gtso mor= /kun gzhi rnam dag mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /sna tshogs gnas dang mchod pa'i bkod par bcas/ /zhing khams 'byor pa phun tshogs rgya mtsho la/ /dbang phyug 'khor los bsgyur ma=/ ji ltar bzhed pa'i don kun 'bad med par/ /smon lam dbang bsgyur gang la gang 'dul ba'i/ /'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par don mdzad ma/ /'dod pa kun stsol khyod la= /stobs sogs yon tan gzhal du med pa yis/ /rab gang rtag tu phan bde spro ba dang*/ /srid zhi'i dge legs thams cad 'bab pa'i gnas/ /chu gter dang mtshungs khyod la= grangs med brjod las 'das pa mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /bye ba phrag stong lhag bcas khrag khrig zung*/ /rnal 'byor ma dpal khyod kyi pho nyar sprul/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyi bdag mo= /sum cu rtsa bdun 'khor los bsgyur ma'i sku/ /myos byas ri bo mnga' dang yon tan grangs/ /zung 'jug lhan skyes ngo bor sdom mkhas ma/ / rje btsun rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ /nyes byas thams cad snying nas so sor bshags/ /yi rang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /rtag tu bzhugs gsol dge ba byang chub bsngo/ / dkyil 'khor gtso bo dpa' bo dpa' mo dang*/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas dbang gi lha mo la/ /ji srid byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/

/bla med theg par bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /dbang bzhi mnos shing dam tshig lam la gnas/ /byin rlabs rgyud sbyangs rim pa gnyis la slob/ /ngo mtshar spyod pa gsum gyi rol pa sogs/ /mtha' dag lam rnams bdag gis bsten par bgyi/ /ting 'dzin brtan cing 'phrin las thogs med 'grub/ /pho nya gsum 'dus grub pa brgyad sogs thob/ /'gro ba'i don spyod mthu dang ldan pa yi/ /tshe 'dir he ru ka dpal thob par shog /rnal 'byor ro gcig bdud rtsi 'thung bas rnam par dag pa'i thugs/ /gnas la sogs pa'i yul du bgrod pas rnam par dag pa'i gsung*/ / dpal ldan gnas kyi dbus su 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor mgon po mchog /bla ma mchog la mgo bos btud de rtag par phyag bgyi'o/ /de nas zhes sogs dag chen pos/ /rgyud ni rdzogs par gyur pa gang*/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i 'dren pa mo/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /lha mo 'phreng bas brgyan pa'i sku yi rin po che/ / lus kun dbang po'i dbang phyug ma yis rtag tu mdzes/ /'khor lo'i gnas kyi mgon po dri med lhan cig skyes/ /sdom pa'i rnal 'byor snying po la ni rtag phyag 'tshal/ /e yig rnam pa'i snying po khu ba'i gnas gyur pad+ma'i sbubs ni dam pa ste/ /de yis dbus su skyes pa'i ngang mo dam pa kun+da ltar dkar thams cad dag /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas shin tu rnam par dag pa'i gnas te lha mo mdzes ma'i gzhi/ /dri med lhan cig skyes pa'i grub gzhi 'dren pa la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skye ba dang ni 'jig pa dang bral mchog gi lus can ma/ /dmar ba'i 'od chags rnam par rgyal ma khams gsum gzugs can ma/ /yon tan tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i sku mnga' rdo rje'i yan lag ma/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bskyed mdzad ma la rtag tu mngon par phyag bgyi'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ nas/ phag mo la 'dud do/ / dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu dbyangs kyi mchod pa ni/

hūṃ khro bo bde ba dgyes pa yi/ /bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba/ /bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rab tu rmongs pa bsten par byed/ /a la la la la ho/ a i ā: a ral+li ho/ bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog pad+ma'i bde/ /a la la la la ho/ dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba mchog /rnal 'byor ma mchog mchod par mdzod/ /a i ā a ral+li ho/ rab dgyes mgon po khyod bzhugs mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro drwa ba'i bde ba stsol/ /dgyes pa'i bde ba gsol bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i gar gyis gar mdzad pa/ /bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol/ /thar ba'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod/ /a la la la la ho/ a i ā a ral+li ho/ bde ba spangs pas grol mi 'gyur/ /bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol/ / bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas/ /chags pa'i dngos por khyod ma gyur/ /bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis/ /bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod/ /'di yis mgon po bskul na ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni nges par 'grub/ /snyan cing 'jebs pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /dpyid kyi rgyal pos glu blangs pas/ /dri med mkha' 'gro drwa ba yis/ /gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/ / de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ /gtor ma rnams/ sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung nas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gi bar gong nang mchod byin rlabs ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs 'dir mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa spyan 'dren mi dgos kyang*/ thugs dam bskul ba'i phyir dang*/ zhing skyong sogs mgron gzhan spyan 'dren dgos pa'i phyir/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas de/ phaiṃ badz+ra a ral+li nas/ dṛ sh+ya ho zhes pas spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇ+ṇa nī ye/

badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ i daṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhe/ ba liṃ/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā lan gsum gyis ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod / oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/rnal 'byor ma dpal 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / zhes pa nas/ bdag la srungs/ dngos grub kun gyi staungs grogs mdzod/ /dus min nas kun 'grub shog /oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ phaiṃ badz+ra a ral+li hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ye shes pa spyi la 'bul/ gtor ma gnyis pa ni/ oṃ hriṃ haṃ haṃ/ he he/ ha ha/ hi hi/ phaiṃ phaiṃ/ zhes lan bdun gyis las kyi mkha' 'gro la 'bul/ de nas gtor ma gsum pa ni/ sgos kyi chos skyong byed na/ dang por phul ba'i rjes la dang*/ min na skabs de nas spyi gtor gyis chog ste/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa nas/ 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang mtshungs pas/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro dang 'byung po spyi la 'bul/ de nas gtor ma bzhi pa gzhi bdag dang*/ lnga pa rigs drug dang yi dwags la kha 'bar ma'i sngags kyis sbyin no/ /skabs 'dir yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod de gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /de nas bum pa sgrub pa ni/ bum pa'i mchod pa bshams/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas ye shes nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar gong bzhin mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul chings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gi kha rgyan dang bcas pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba breng ma chad par spros gzungs thag la brten nas song bas/ bum nang gi rje btsun ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pas bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ gsum ma brgya rtsa sogs dang*/ oṃ sum+bha sogs nyi shu rtsa gcig dang*/ oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'ang ji ltar 'os pa bzla/ de nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bā rā hī ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā nas shap+ta'i bar du sbyar/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe nas ā khaṃ swāhā/ zhes rol chen phul/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ / oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyi nang mchod/ oṃ na mo nas/ kha ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis bstod/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ / sogs sho lo ka gcig /yig brgya lan gsum/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bdun gyi dung chos kyi chu phul/ skabs 'dir bum pa'i lha zhu ba dang gshegs su gsol bar mi bzhed/ rjes chog gi skabs lhan cig tu byed pa yin/ de nas bdag 'jug ni/ tshogs pa yod na bum chu 'gyed/ gang ltar yang*/ sum+bha bzlas te gnas dang yo byad la gtor/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sku khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba nas shrī ye hūṃ de nas/

oṃ badz+ra bhū me āḥhūṃ/ sogs maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo dbyer med ma mchis pa la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos spyi'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bgyi'o/ / zhes brjod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ zhes pa nas/ mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ lan gsum slob ma dbang bskur yin na skabs 'dir bgegs gtor gtong dgos kyang*/ bdag 'jug gi skabs 'dir rdo rje gsor/ yungs kar sogs 'thor zhing*/ drag rol dang bcas/ oṃ sum+bha sogs bzla'o/ / mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i lte ba'i baṃ las me 'od 'phros/ bdag gi spyi bo nas zhugs rtsa thams cad kyi nang gang*/ bgegs dang sdig sgrib dri ma thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs par gyur/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan ta kṛ ta hūṃ hūṃ/ lan bdun/ spyi bo tshangs bug sna tshogs rdo rjes bkag par gyur/ lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mos nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams su gyur/ de skabs gnas rnams su rdo rje rgya gram du reg oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis nang mchod myang*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyi bzung*/ /theg chen bdud rtsir rab bshad par/ /'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs/ /ji srid 'khor ba gnas kyi bar/ /mya ngan mi mda' gsol bar 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog sog sa lan gsum gong bzhin/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod / oṃ hriḥbi shud+dha dharma sarba pā paṃ niṣ+tsa a s+ye sho dha ya sho dha ya/ sarba bi kalpa na a pa na ya hūṃ/ khrus chu cung zad btung*/ slob ma'i bya ba yin na/ skabs 'dir sdom bzung gi don du maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa 'bul/ bdag 'jug gi skabs 'dir/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa/ blo yis blangs nas bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/

thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa 'bul/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /bla ma'i sku la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gsung*/ /bla ma'i gsung la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin thugs/ /bla ma'i thugs la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas grong khyer nyams dga' ba/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs 'khor lo yi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ / mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par mdzod/ / ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod kyi bar rigs lnga'i sdom bzung spyi dang mthun par bya/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ / rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ / 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas pa/ /de'i tshangs spyod gnyis med par/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*/ /lan gsum gyis 'khor lo sdom pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom bzung bya/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha bā ra mā na ya hūṃ/ mig dar/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ me tog / oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gnas gsum du bdud rtsi'i thig le bya/ rang gi snying gar kun rdzob byang sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i steng du don dam byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa'o/

/oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi/ rdo rje snying gar gtugs/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ zhes brtan par byas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs par gyur/ slob ma 'jug na skabs 'dir yol ba bsal/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur gyi/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod dpal he ru ka dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis 'di dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar ma byed cig /smras na dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ rdo rje snying gar gtugs/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral de gshegs/ /deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nga yin gyi ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig

/byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar gyur ta re/ bum chu cung zad btung zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ / rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hūṃ/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal rdo rje phag mo bdag la dbab du gsol/ lan gsum/ rang gzhan srid pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i snod bcud thams cad sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin dang bral ba'o/ /rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam pa can du bzhugs/ rdo rje slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs gnyis su med pa 'di ni/ srid zhi ma lus pa'i legs pa thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo ste/ bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ rang nyid 'od kyi rang bzhin gyi lus rtsa a wa dhū ti chos bzhi ldan gtso bor gyur pa'i rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi sku gsung thugs kyi sgo dang bcas pa gsal bar grub cing*/ lte bar chos 'byung gi dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'i sku tshon gang pa gar bsgyur bas bzhugs shing 'bar ba'i 'od can lhag ger snang ba'o/ /mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i lte ba'i baṃ las 'od 'phros/ rang gi lte bar gnas pa'i rdo rje phag mo'i sku la thim pas/ drod dang bde ba'i nyams cher g.yo ba dang lhan cig sku las skyes pa'i me lce 'bar ba'i snang bas lus gang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad rdo rje phag mo'i rnam par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das ma mkha' dbyings gang ba rnams char bzhin babs te/ rang la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ rol mo sgra dang bcas/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra bā rā hī dz+nyā na a be shā ya/ a a hrīḥhrīḥswāhā/

zhes mang du brjod de ye shes dbab pa dang po'o/ /de nas langs te rkang pa gshibs/ brang pa sa la btsugs/ lag pa thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor brkyang*/ zhes bshad pa dngos su ma 'grub na yid kyis mos/ sna rtse nas sor brgyad gzhal ba'i nam mkha' la g.yung drung ris dkar po me tog 'bar ba gnas par gyur/ rang gi lte ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku las yang dag pa ye shes kyi gtum mo 'bar ba'i ngo bo glog dang mtshungs pa'i 'od zer byung*/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ smin mtshams gnad kyi sgo phye zhing sna sgo nas 'thon/ g.yung drung 'khyil ba la reg pas de nyid g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor te/ snod bcud thams cad gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur/ rlung phyir bzung ba dang lhan cig rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /spogs pa'i cho ga'o/ / rang gi spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkha' la bla ma he ru ka bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkhar byon/ rjes su chags pa'i snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems chu rgyun ltar babs te/ spyi bo tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhi brgyud de lus thams cad gang bas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang phyi nang gi snang ba thams cad bde ba chen po'i ye shes gcig gi ngo bor gyur/ mthar sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yang bdud rtsi thig le'i ngo bor zhu ste/ bdag nyid la thim/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ shin tu spogs pa'i cho ga'o/ /ye shes 'bebs pa phyi ma gnyis kyi skabs 'dir/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ phaiṃ phaiṃ hrīḥhrīḥ ces btags pa bzla ste/ rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i skabs 'dir ye shes 'bebs pa 'di rnams gnad kyi dam pa gal che shos shig yin te/ dbang gi sngon 'gro'i ming btags kyang dngos gzhi rku thabs su bstan pa yin pas/

ye shes 'pho ba'i dbang zhes pa la yang nges pa rnyed par bya'o/ /yang 'di skad du/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos/ /sems nyid cir yang grub pa med/ /grub pa med pa'i sems nyid la/ /sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che/ /snang tsam nyid kyang sems su 'dug /snang ba sems kyi de nyid 'di/ /bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin/ /rnam par mi rtog bsam mi khyab/ /gsal ba de yi ngo bor snang*/ /mos pa du ma'i sems can la/ /thabs rnams sna tshogs kun tu ston/ /sna tshogs sgyu ma'i sbyor ba yis/ /dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /bsam gyis mi khyab go 'phang thob/ / 'di ni rje btsun byin rlabs te/ /sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin du/ /skal ldan rnams kyi spyod yul yin/ / zhes brjod cing don la mnyam par bzhag /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ lan gnyis/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ / bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*/ /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog / lan gsum/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ me tog 'bul/ oṃ pra ti gṛ h+ṇa staṃ/ i maṃ sa twa mahā ba la/ me tog mgo bor bzhag /mig 'bras gnyis oṃ yig 'od du 'bar bar gyur/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ mig dar phye/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu skye/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kun/ khyod la myur du mngon du gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*/ /gsang sngags sgrub la brtson par bgyi/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum nyid du mthong bar gyur/ slob ma dbang bskur la skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor dang lha'i rnam pa bshad do/ /'og gzhi'i chos 'byung ni/ dug gsum gyi chos nyid/

bdud rtsi'i nang gi chos 'byung ni khams gsum gyi de bzhin nyid/ me long gi chos 'byung ni sku gsum gyi ye shes so/ / g.yung drung ris ni chos nyid mi 'gyur ba/ bzhi ni dga' ba bzhi/ yig 'bru rnams sku gsung thugs gcig tu 'dus pa/ zur gsum ni rnam thar gsum/ nang stong pa ni spros bral/ dmar ba ni snying rje/ rtsa ba phra ba ni nyon mongs pa spangs pa/ gdengs ka che ba ni ye shes dang yon tan rgyas pa'o/ /pad+ma'i gdan nyon mongs pas ma gos/ zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi snang ba spros pa'o ces pa'i bar yang gong bzhin brjod/ de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs la tshang ba'o/ /de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi bum dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal rgyas par phul/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol/ / lan gsum/ chos kyi 'byung gnas dkyil 'khor gyi dam pa'i shar phyogs su dbang stegs rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ mdun bskyed/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa he ru ka yab yum/ byang chub sems dpa' yab yum/ rdo rje khro bo mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams mkha' dbyings gang ba dbang gi don du spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ ar+ghaṃ nas / shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsal du gsol/ oṃ sum+bha lan gsum bzlas te byur bsal/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs/ me tog dor zhing shis pa brjod/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa rnams kyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/

khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ bum pa spyi bor 'jog /bum chu btung*/ bum nang gi lha las lha sku gnyis pa zhig chad rang la thim/ ye shes kyi chus lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ 'khor lo bzhi gang bas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes brtan par byas/ sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje sgrib pa dang bral bar gyur/ mas brtan gyis rim pas bde chen 'khor lo'i bar du steng du gshegs pas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun brtan par gyur/ dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs/ bh+ruṃ hūṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ maṃ tāṃ paṃ laṃ rnams las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yab yum gyi ngo bor gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyi phyag tu thogs te bdag nyid la dbang bskur/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs dang*/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ ces dbu rgyan 'ching ba'am/ rin po che'i phyag rgya spyi bor 'jog oṃ maṃ tāṃ paṃ laṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra paṭ+ṭa ka a ra li ho/ ces pa'i dar dpyangs bcing pa'am/ 'ching ba'i tshul bya / de ltar na bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ lus kyi dri ma dag /lam bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ sku rdo rje sprul sku mngon du 'gyur pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs so/ /maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa'am/ gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du ces 'don pa spos pa'i 'bring rgyas gang rung phul/ khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /ngag gi dri ma sbyong mdzad pa'i/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol/ /mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum thams cad spyan drangs/ bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor dang ro gcig tu 'dres/ de nyid bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag par gyur/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas

kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gi ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdud rtsi myang*/ rtsa thams cad byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ dug gsum gyi rnam rtog 'gags/ gsal stong bde ba'i ye shes skyes par gyur/ de ltar na gsang dbang thob pas/ ngag gi dri ma dag /lam rang lus thabs ldan sgom pa la dbang*/ gsung rdo rje longs sku mngon du 'gyur= / yang maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa'am/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du zhes 'don pa spos/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje la/ /gsang ba'i de nyid bstan pa ltar/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ / lan gsum/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor las lha sku dang yig 'bru dang phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas lus ngag yid gsum/ bde stong zung 'jug tu byin gyis brlobs/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa mang du byung ste spyi bor thim/ bcom ldan 'das ma nyid kyi sku mang du byon nas lte ba'i baṃ yig la thim pas/ de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur bzhengs/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs yin na/ gnas de dang de dag tu sin+dhu ra'i thig le byed pa yin/ bdag 'jug gi skabs su mos pa tsam bya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum bya/ lte ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku lus gtum mo 'bar te/ spyi bor haṃ yig zhu bas/ dga' ba dang*/ mchog tu dga' ba dang*/ khyad par gyi dga' ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba rnams lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi rim pa'i shar bar gyur/ de ltar na shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas yid kyi dri ma dag /lam gzhan lus shes rab sgom pa la dbang*/ thugs rdo rje chos sku mngon du 'gyur= / maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa'am/ dbang bzhi zhu ba'i yon du ces 'don pa spos/ khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin gyis/

/gtso bo dbang bskur rnams gsum thob/ /de dang rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ /bdag la bka' drin bskyab tu gsol/ / lan gsum/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ /rdo rje snying po nam mkha' mtshungs/ /rdul bral mthar sbyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /de ltar na dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku mngon du 'gyur= / mtha' bsten rjes gnang drug las/ dang po sku'i rjes gnang ni slob ma dbang bskur la/ dag pa gsum nas/ rigs bdag gi bar gyi dmigs pa 'bogs pa yin yang*/ skabs 'dir 'di skad ces bya stai/ tshogs bsags byin rlabs srung 'khor bsgom/ /dag pa gsum po sngon 'gro bas/ /lus ni srung 'khor gzhal yas khang*/ /ngag dang yid ni lha mo'i sku/ /sa bon dang bcas dam tshig pa/ /ye shes spyan 'dren go cha dgod/ / dbang bskur rgyas btab mchod bstod do/ / zha ེ sa brjod cing don dran tsam bya/ gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i baṃ yig las sngags rnams kyi 'phreng ba byung*/ rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ snying kha'i gzungs sngags la thim pa'i sngags nus pa mthu dang ldan par byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum/ bar 'dir dam bca' ba'i lung byas na'ang legs/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum me tog spyi bor bzhag / bcom ldan 'di la rtsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gi rgyud la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung rig sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa thogs med du yongs su 'jug par gyur cig/ gsum pa lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ sogs/ shap+ta'i

bar/ bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyi dngos/ /bdag nyid lha mo kun gyi gnas/ /de phyir bdag gis thams cad bya/ /bdag nyid rnal 'byor ma dpal mchod/ / bzhi pa spyod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ rnal 'byor ma dpal phyag rgya ni/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te lhung bzed bzung*/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ / bud med yin na/ rnal 'byor ma yis zhes 'don pa spos/ gzhan rnams thun mong du ster bas 'don pa spo mi dgos/ de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /de nyid shes nas de nas ni/ /dpa' bos 'dod pa lnga spyad do/ / lnga pa chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ni dung dang po ti sogs gtad par mos la/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung chos can/ /sems can sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no/ khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /'gro ba'i don ni mnyam med byos/ / drug pa srung ba'i byin rlabs ni/ lte bar oṃ baṃ nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ sum+bha tshar gcig brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur yin na skabs 'dir/ srung 'khor ram/ dpung skud 'dogs/ de nas/ gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /

lan gsum/ maṇ+ḍal rgyas 'bring gang rung phul la/ byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi don du/ zhes 'don pa spo/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*/ /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ dge ba bsngo/ bar 'dir tshogs mchod bya ste/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs mchod gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /lhag gtor dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma dus gcig la gtong*/ de nas rjes chog ni mchod pa rnams kha gsos la bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du zhes pa nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar gong ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas kha ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i bar bum bskyed ltar mchod bstod byed/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams chag thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang 'byor pa dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa tshe 'di nyid la stsal tu gsol/ gal te tshe 'dir 'grub pa'i skal ba med na 'chi tshe mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid pa dang*/ mthar thug zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don zhu/ de nas stobs bzhi tshang pa'i sgo nas bshags pa ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gnyis med ye shes sku/ /'gro la brtse bas rjes chags lha mo'i skur/ /ston mdzad rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs bcas dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag 'khrul bas sngon bsags sdig kun dang*/ /sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba gang bgyis pa/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i drung du mthol lo bshags/ /'gyod cing slan chad sdom par bgyi lags so/

/rigs lnga'i dam tshig tshul bzhin ma bsgrubs dang*/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhis gos pa dang*/ /sbom po brgyad sogs nyes pa gang lags pa/ /dri bral lha mo'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /thun bzhi'i ting 'dzin chags gam nor ba dang*/ /bzlas pa'i bya ba 'khrul dang cho ga nyam/ /gus pa lhod dang rnam g.yeng dbang gyur dang*/ /nyon mongs drag po'i dbang gyur= / rgyun dang khyad par bza' ba'i dam tshig la/ /ngan par rtog dang brnyas dang 'goms pa dang*/ /tshes bcu'i mchod dang 'khor lo'i mchod pa sogs/ /ngan cing dus su ma thongs= /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha mtshan ma dang*/ /lhag ma 'gom dang dam can la sogs brnyas/ /sngags dang lha dang rgyud tshig dri med la/ /kyal ka byas sogs nongs pa shes rab rigs la smad dang brdeg pa dang*/ /skor dang phyag 'tshal la sogs ma grub dang*/ /ma dad nyon mongs rang dgar chags pa dang*/ /rang gzhan bde chen rgyu nyam rdo rje rnam pa gsum gyi dam tshig dang*/ / thun mong ma yin dam tshig brgyad po dang*/ /dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnam bzhi dang*/ /'gal bar gyur pa thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /snod ma yin la gsang ba bsgrags pa dang*/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs rigs sngags sbyin pa dang*/ /'os min 'phrin las gsol dang gnas min par/ /sngags rgyud sbyor ba byas sogs= /bshags dang bshags bya bshags par byed po bral/ /'dzin pa dag phyir dag 'tshangs phul bas kyang*/ / sgrib gnyis rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag pa'i/ /gnas lugs rtogs nas sangs rgyas thob par shog /oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes sogs he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ / bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa dang*/ yo byad ma tshang ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/

sngags ma dag pa dang*/ cho ga lhag pa dang chad pa thams cad lhag chad kha bskang zhing*/ bdag cag gi lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes bzod par gsol/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa'i rten sku 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba bzhis gnod pa ma byung gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs sin+dhu ra'i ye shes pa bshegs/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ mo/ hreṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ sum+bha nas lan gnyis kyi tshams rngam/ sngags kyi srung ba byed do/ / bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rang bzhin/ oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod nas/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gi rang bzhin/ dran rig rnam par rtog pa thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ye shes chen po'i cho 'phrul du rnam par dag pa yin no/ / de nas smon lam ni/ bdag gi dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ /blo ldan rigs bzang nga rgyal med pa dang*/

/snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus bstan/ /rdo rje phag mo'i dam tshig la gnas shog /rdo rje dril bu la sogs rtag tu 'chang*/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos don rtogs pa dang*/ /go ku shu kra la sogs rtag bza' zhing*/ /mthar thug bde chen sgrub pa'i skal ldan shog /bde gshegs spyan sngar gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yi/ /dam bcas srung zhing dngos grub mchog stsol bar/ /thugs dam bcas shing rtag srung dngos grub ni/ /rnam gsum tshe 'di nyid la thob par shog /lha mo tshad ma nas rgyur gyur cig / ces smon lam btab/ de nas rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ chos kun gdod nas rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas bde chen lhan cig skyes/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spyi yi gzugs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ /gdul dka' 'dul mdzad dpal ldan he ru ka /shes rab rang bzhin rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /lak+ṣiṃ ka ra rnal 'byor ma dpal dngos/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor o rgyan bir+wa pa/ /kun 'dar gsang ste spyod pa'i gnyis spangs zhabs/ /ri khrod dbang phyug mtha' dag grub pa'i gtso/ /yi dam dngos su zhal gzigs bsod snyoms pa/ /bla mas rjes bzung bud+dha dad+da'i zhabs/ /phag mos rjes bzung lho 'byung zla ba ste/ /mchog dbang mdzes pa mkhas shing grub pa'i phul/ /bla ma mnyes mdzad kun dga' rdo rje'i zhabs/ /mtshan rtags mngon gyur mnga' ris dkon mchog 'bar/ /sngags ston nus ldan rgyal tshab rin po che/ / 'gro la phan mdzad byams dpal lo ts+tsha ba/ /bla chen bsod dbang man ngag gdams pa'i mdzod/ /sems dpa' bsod seng dus ngan 'gro ba'i skyabs/ / chos sgo du ma'i brgyud 'dzin rin bzang ba/ gnas lnga rig pa'i dbang phyug bu ston rje/ /bshes gnyen bzang po'i rang bzhin brag nag pa/ /sdom brtson mkhas pa 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal ba/

/ngur smrig 'dzin mchog rgyal dbang grags pa dang*/ /rgyal ba phyag na bstan srung bran du khol/ /zab don rnal 'byor bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /'jam dbyangs chos dbang mkhas btsun bzang po phul/ /kun dga' dpal 'byor yon tan du mas brgyan/ /dam pa'i rjes 'jug dkon mchog rin chen zhabs/ /lung rig rgya mtsho spros bral gnas lugs gzigs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma skyabs gnas kun gyi dngos/ / re re'i mthar/ phyag 'tshal mchod do snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /thub pa'i bstan la rnam dag bslab pa gsum/ /legs nos rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa dang*/ /byang chub sems bskyed pha rol phyin drug sogs/ /theg mchog lam la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ khyad par gsang ba'i theg pa bla med du/ /dbang bzhis smin byas rnam dag dam tshig srung*/ /rdo rje slob dpon mchog dang lhag pa'i lhas/ /yang dag ye shes 'pho bar dag snang lha yi 'khor lor 'jug pa'i sgo/ /kun rdzob snang zhen sbyong ba'i thabs kyi mchog /zab mo snying po'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa las/ /rab 'byams dngos grub 'grub par= /sna tshogs sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor bgrang yas rnams/ /don dam lhan cig skyes par nges sdom pa/ /bde chen tsaṇ+ḍa li dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdzogs rim ye shes rtogs par= /lam 'di sgrub la bar chad kun zhi zhing*/ /mtha' dag nyer 'tsho phun tshogs kun bsgrub nas/ /rdo rje pho nya gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yis/ /lam gyi grogs mchog sgrub par= 'khor lo rnam bzhi'i bsgrod pa rnam dag nas/ /bcu gnyis sa yi rim pas legs bgrod pa'i/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / de nas bkra shis ni/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung pa'i/ /he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i pad+mor rdo rje rol par mdzad/ /bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs shog

/bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi 'byung gnas nyams dga' bar/ /sna tshogs chu skyes nyin byed gdan la bde bar bzhugs/ /rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum mchog rnal 'byor ma/ /bden pa des kyang = /bkra shis gang zhig gsang chen zab mo'i don ston pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro grangs med gsung gi snying po sum cu gnyis/ /sa gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer bye ba'i 'phro 'du can bden pa= /bkra shis gang zhig 'gyur med lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings/ khams gsum kun la bde ba chen pos khyab pa'i thugs/ /tshad med yon tan 'phrin las tshogs kyi nyer 'bar ma/ /bden pa des kyang = /bkra shis gang zhig zhing skyong ma mo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs 'dzoms zhi rgyas dbang gi las mdzad cing*/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo rgya chen rtag tu brtan gyur pa/ /bden pa dais kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol/ / yang brjod pa/ grub pa'i gzhung lugs mkhas pa'i legs bshad can/ /dam pa'i man ngag byin rlabs ma nyams pa/ /rdzogs rim las tshogs la sogs yan lag rgyas/ /lam bzang 'di dang phrad pa skal pa bzang*/ khungs med gtam gyis blun po mgo bskor nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin yin snyam gad mo'i gnas/ /'gro mang de rjes 'jug pa blun mod kyi/ /dge min las kyi 'bras bur thub pas gsungs/ / gsar rnying phan tshun bsres pa'i rdzun chog dang*/ /lha lnga ma la lhan skyes zer zhing 'khrul/ /rgya gar nag chung te pu zangs gling pa'i/ /lugs la te na mar mi brgyud par 'dren/ /gdon gyis bskul nas brdol thabs smras pa la/ las zad skya ser pho mo chu ltar rgyug/ma rtogs na yang rtogs zhes rdzun tshig smra/ / bsod nams blo gros can rnams bag yod byed/ /ces pa'ang smras so/ /mchog gyur sgrub thabs mchog 'di bshad pa las/ /mkha' spyod chen po mkha' khams chos kyi dbyings/ /bde chen dkyil 'khor bde ba'i lam gyis bsgrubs/ /bla med byang chub bla ma'i drin thob

shog/ // ces rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bden gnyis zhal can sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga bde ba chen po'i dpal 'bar ba zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdags skyong gzhon nu chos bzhin pa kun dga' rab brtan dbang gi rgyal po'i bkas bskul nas/ /tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o/ / mad+ga laṃ bi stā raṃ/ / gcig zhus// ༄༅/ /smon lam dang bkra shis bzhugs/ smon lam ni sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba'i/ skye zhing skye bar rigs mchog tu zhes sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i bsngo smon rgyas par brjod/ bkra shis ni/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi= zhes sogs zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa sngon du 'gro bas me tog char du bsnyil zhing*/ bkra shis 'byung gnas rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtshor khyab cing bdag /yid bzhin nor ltar gsol btab 'dod don thogs pa med par stsol/ /byin rlabs char bas skal ldan zhing sar smin grol 'bras bu bskyed/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bkra shis snang bas khams gsum yongs grol shog /bkra shis gang zhig bde chen chos sku'i nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /'od gsal longs sku nges pa lnga ldan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /gang 'dul sprul sku'i 'od zer drwa bas 'gro blo'i pad tshal 'byed/ /sku bzhi dbyer med bkra shis dpal 'bar ma rig mun sel shog / bkra shis gang zhig dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos dbyings pho brang du/ /rdo rje 'chang chen nā da'i sgras bstan rin chen rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ /phyag rgya sngags dang ye shes mthar thug ston pa rnam lnga'i lha/ /ngo mtshar dkyil 'khor bkra shis dpal 'bar lnga phung dbyings grol shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi 'byung gnas thar pa chen po'i grong*/ /byang chub phyogs chos bkod pas rab mdzes kun bzang mchod sprin 'khrigs/ /tshogs brgyad rnam dag dur khrod brgyad ldan rdo rje bsrung 'khor gtams/ /gzhal med khang chen bkra shis dpal 'bar dag pa rab 'byams shog

/bkra shis gang zhig rdo rje btsun mo'i bha gar legs bzhugs pa/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje sku bzhi ye shes rnam pa lnga yi dngos/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid e waṃ rang bzhin zung du 'jug /dkyil 'khor gtso mchog bkra shis dpal 'bar dngos grub gnyis thob shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos dbyings gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid sgyu 'phrul drwa ba sna tshogs rol pa can/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bdag rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i bkra shis dpal 'bar rnam dag shog /bkra shis gang zhig snying po'i mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /dga' chen sngags kyi me tog phreng bas mkha' mnyam sku lus brgyan/ /gnyis snang sha chen rtog med gsol mdzad dpal ldan thugs rje'i stobs/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po'i bkra shis dpal 'bar nyon mongs 'ching gcod shog /bkra shis gang zhig 'khor 'das rtog pa'i drwa ba ji snyed pa/ /lhan skyes 'od gsal phyag rgyas mi shigs chen po sdom/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pa rnal 'byor ma dpal dpyid kyi bdud rtsis dgyes/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i bkra shis dpal 'bar bde ba mchog brnyes shog

bkra shis gang zhig rgyal kun mthu stobs 'phrin las bsdus pa'i sku/ /dran pa tsam gyis bdud sde lha min dus kyi mun pa kun/ /cig car 'joms pa'i nyin byed ye shes gzi brjid 'bum 'phro ba/ /'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i bkra shis dpal 'bar bdud bzhi las rgyal shog /bkra shis gang zhig nam mkha' dang mnyam snying po'i ye shes lnga/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las mtha' yas sgyu ma'i gar/ /dug lnga'i dpung 'joms dkyil 'khor rnam lnga rten dang brten par bcas/ /gdod nas yongs grub bkra shis dpal 'bar sku lnga lhun grub shog /bkra shis gang zhig sangs rgyas rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las/ /ye shes rigs lnga'i sprin 'phro dngos grub gnyis su char rgyun 'bebs/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs zhing sngags lhan cig skyes/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis dpal 'bar sgrub la mchog stsol shog /bkra shis gang zhig snying rje rab khros myur mdzad nag po che/ /phyogs skyong ma mo 'byung po tshogs bcas bka' yi gnyer/ /rtag tu zhi yang 'bar ba'i gzugs kyis rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong*/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis dpal 'bar bsam don yongs 'grub shog /bkra shis gang zhig don dam bden pa 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /brtan g.yo kun khyab snying po'i rang bzhin lhun grub yon tan ldan/ / srid dang zhi ba'i dge legs kun 'byung gzhom du med pa'i dbyings/ /rnam kun mchog ldan bkra shis dpal 'bar rtag brtan kun khyab shog / ces pa'am/ yang na/ yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyis ri bo bzhin/ /zha ེ sa sogs bkra shis bka' rgya ma lta bu'i shis pa'i tshig rgya cher brjod do/ /lhag bsam dge bas rab dkar bsod nams 'dis/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma dgyes byed mchod sprin dang*/ /bdag gzhan sgrib sbyong tshogs chen rab rdzogs shing*/ /don gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal yon myur spyod shog/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/
